title: Gulf upper-ocean salinity structure in GLORYS
query: Using daily GLORYS potential temperature and salinity in the Gulf of Mexico (98–82 W, 18–30 N) from July 2011 to August 2015, calculate the salinity maximum and its depth within 50–300 m for each valid water column. Map their time means and compare regional profiles west and east of 90 W. Describe where the salinity maximum is pronounced and discuss the limits of using this diagnostic as evidence for Subtropical Underwater. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
